frozen_after: Two identical 55-second full-atlas executions for each preregistered H13 rank 327 and 330 timed out with no result file.

method.denominator_and_target: Certify D(s)>0 exactly; for the frozen single left boundary certify the target numerator is strictly increasing, negative at L, positive at witness, and isolate the unique root by exact rational bisection.
method.non_target_conditions: Certify every non-target KKT numerator strictly positive over the complete source segment. Fixed index blocks are only execution partitions; no conditions may be omitted.
method.independent_regression: At four frozen exact rational probes, compare every symbolic numerator identity to direct 8x8 matrix evaluation; require zero mismatches, positivity on strict probes, and frozen target nonpositive on the outside probe.
method.classification: Resolved only if target crossing and all non-target positivity/direct checks pass exactly.

adjudication.support: Every frozen block and direct probe passes exactly.
adjudication.refute_or_failed: Any exact contradiction, wrong target sign/monotonicity, non-target nonpositivity, or direct symbolic/matrix mismatch.
adjudication.inconclusive: Any frozen block/probe cannot be completed or returns an unresolved certificate without contradiction.

no_posthoc_changes: No rank, condition block, target, witness, support, threshold, tolerance, or prediction may be changed after diagnostic outcomes are inspected.

scope.meaning: These certificates can mathematically resolve the frozen H13 predictions for repeated-timeout ranks 327 and 330 but do not retroactively make their original full-atlas executions complete.
